title: Marigold · Pregnancy Tracker
metaDesc: A calm, private pregnancy companion: week-by-week guidance, 270+ sourced “Can I…?” answers, a symptom guide and gentle trackers. No ads, no account.
heroTitle: A calm companion for the next nine months.
heroBody: Week-by-week guidance, clear answers to “Can I…?” with real sources, and gentle tools for every day — all private, right on your iPhone.
ctaNote: Free to use · iPhone · No account needed
featuresTitle: Everything you reach for, in one gentle place
f1b: Your baby’s size, what’s developing, what you may feel, and three practical tips for every week from 1 to 42.
f2b: 270+ foods, medicines, beauty products and activities — each with a clear verdict, the reason why and links to the guidance behind it.
f3b: 55 common symptoms explained calmly, with what helps and clear signs for when to call your midwife, doctor or emergency services.
f4b: Kick counter and contraction timer with Live Activities on your Lock Screen, plus widgets, appointments, water, vitamins and more.
f5b: Bump photos, moods, notes and letters to your baby. There’s no account — your journal never leaves your phone.
f6b: In English, Türkçe, Español, Deutsch, Français and Português, with local foods, national guidance and your country’s emergency number.
privacyBody: No ads, no analytics, no tracking and no account. Everything you enter stays on your device. Purchases are handled by Apple, with an anonymous ID for confirming them.
plusBody: Core features are free. Plus adds a doctor-ready PDF report, your journal as a keepsake book and a bump-photo collage — monthly with a free trial, or a one-time Pregnancy Pass.
disclaimer: Marigold shares general information from public health guidance. It is not medical advice and not a medical device. Always follow your midwife or doctor, and in an emergency call your local emergency number.
sister: From the makers of Baby Bloom — a gentle companion for life with your newborn.
